feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 September 2026 8:28am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 24 September 2026 at 8:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the east of England, and deep area of low pressure to the southwest of Iceland bringing a weak warm front approaches from the west.


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, veering south or southwest around midday, increasing 5 or 6 in the afternoon, but remaining 4 in southeast waters. Then veering west 2 to 4 in all waters overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight soon building slight or moderate this afternoon becoming slight again overnight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then occasional rain overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 2 to 4, quickly backing southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 in the evening and occasionally 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain at first quickly clearing to become fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain at first.
